title: Influence of Body Composition on Chemotherapy Outcomes in Localized Breast Cancer
official: Influence of Body Composition, Total Body Fat and Body Mass Index on the Pharmacokinetics of Docetaxel in Localized Breast Cancer
summary: The purpose of this study is to determine if pharmacokinetics of docetaxel is modified by the body composition (assessed by the BMI but also by CT-scan) in patients treated by docetaxel as adjuvant treatment of a localized breast cancer
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Woman older than
* Early breast cancer
* CT-scan of less than 3 months, including L3 level
* Indication of docetaxel at 100 mg/m² as adjuvant CT

Exclusion Criteria:

* HER2 amplified or triple negative tumors
* Pregnant or breastfeeding women
* Patients under guardianship or curatorship
* Concomitant administration of another cytotoxic drug or targeted therapy
* Psychosocial disorder
* Administration of another cytotoxic drug or targeted therapy within 20 days prior to blood collection
